import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Define lexicon of common aggressive/insulting terms found in dataset examples
ABUSE_LEXICON = [
    "stupid",
    "idiot",
    "ass",
    "damn",
    "hell",
    "fuck",
    "shit",
    "dumb",
    "retard",
    "moron",
    "faggot",
    "bitch",
    "troll",
    "idiotic",
    "useless",
    "waste",
    "nazi",
    "cunt",
    "fag",
]

# Load data
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_submission_path = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)


# Preprocessing: Clean text for model input only
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        text = text.replace('\\"', "")
        text = text.lower()
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
        text = text.replace(" ", " ")
        return text
    return text


# Enhanced feature extraction for insult detection with punctuation clustering
def extract_text_features(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return np.zeros(20, dtype=np.float32)
    t = text.strip()
    if len(t) == 0:
        return np.zeros(20, dtype=np.float32)

    words = t.split()
    num_words = len(words)
    num_chars = len(t)

    # Basic counts
    num_exclamation = sum(1 for c in t if c == "!")
    num_question = sum(1 for c in t if c == "?")
    num_period = sum(1 for c in t if c == ".")
    num_punct = sum(1 for c in t if c in "!?.,;:'\"()[]{}")

    # Character-level metrics
    special_char_count = sum(1 for c in t if not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace())
    special_char_ratio = special_char_count / max(num_chars, 1)

    # Case metrics
    num_upper = sum(1 for c in t if c.isupper())
    num_cap = sum(1 for c in t if c.isupper() and c.isalpha())
    words_cap = sum(1 for w in words if w and w[0].isupper())

    # Sentence detection
    sentences = re.findall(r"[.!?]+(?:\s+|$)", t)
    num_sentences = len(sentences)
    avg_word_len = num_chars / max(num_words, 1)

    # Word ending patterns
    words_ing = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("-ing") or w.endswith("ing"))
    words_ed = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("-ed") or w.endswith("ed"))

    # Density features
    exclamation_density = num_exclamation / max(num_words, 1)
    question_density = num_question / max(num_words, 1)
    upper_word_ratio = words_cap / max(num_words, 1)
    cap_word_ratio = num_cap / max(num_chars, 1)
    word_len_ratio = avg_word_len / max(5, 1)
    ing_ratio = words_ing / max(num_words, 1)
    ed_ratio = words_ed / max(num_words, 1)

    # Abuse word features
    abuse_word_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in ABUSE_LEXICON)
    abuse_word_density = abuse_word_count / max(num_words, 1)

    # Direct address patterns
    t_lower = t.lower()
    you_are_count = len(re.findall(r"\byou are\b", t_lower))
    youre_a_count = len(re.findall(r"\byoure a\b|\byour a\b", t_lower))
    what_a_count = len(re.findall(r"\bwhat a\b", t_lower))

    # NEW: Punctuation intensity and clustering features
    # Exclamation to period ratio
    if num_period > 0:
        excl_period_ratio = num_exclamation / num_period
    else:
        excl_period_ratio = float(num_exclamation)

    # Punctuation per sentence
    punct_per_sentence = num_punct / max(num_sentences, 1)

    # Consecutive punctuation count (simplified)
    punct_sequences = len(re.findall(r"[!.,]{2,}", t))
    consec_punct_density = punct_sequences / max(num_chars, 1)

    # First sentence intensity (insults often start strong)
    if num_sentences > 0:
        first_sentence = re.match(r"^(?:\S+\.?\s*)*(?:.?)", t).group()
        excl_in_first = sum(1 for c in first_sentence if c == "!")
        excl_first_ratio = excl_in_first / max(num_exclamation, 1)
    else:
        excl_first_ratio = float(num_exclamation)

    # Punctuation cluster score (combination)
    punct_cluster_score = (
        excl_period_ratio + consec_punct_density + excl_first_ratio
    ) / 3

    return np.array(
        [
            num_chars,
            num_words,
            num_exclamation,
            num_question,
            num_period,
            num_punct,
            upper_word_ratio,
            cap_word_ratio,
            word_len_ratio,
            ing_ratio,
            ed_ratio,
            special_char_ratio,
            abuse_word_density,
            you_are_count,
            youre_a_count,
            what_a_count,
            excl_period_ratio,
            punct_per_sentence,
            consec_punct_density,
            excl_first_ratio,
            punct_cluster_score,
        ],
        dtype=np.float32,
    )


# Keep original comments for submission to match test exactly
train_df_clean = train_df.copy()
test_df_clean = test_df.copy()

train_df_clean["Comment"] = train_df_clean["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df_clean["Comment"] = test_df_clean["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Prepare features
X_train_strings = train_df_clean["Comment"].values
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values
X_test_strings = test_df_clean["Comment"].values

# Vectorization with word n-grams
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.8
)
X_train_tfidf_word = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(X_train_strings)
X_test_tfidf_word = vectorizer_word.transform(X_test_strings)

# Character-level n-gram features (bigrams and trigrams)
vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 3), min_df=2, max_df=0.8, max_features=50000
)
X_train_tfidf_char = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_train_strings)
X_test_tfidf_char = vectorizer_char.transform(X_test_strings)

# Extract Enhanced Text Features including new punctuation features
train_stats = np.array([extract_text_features(c) for c in X_train_strings])
test_stats = np.array([extract_text_features(c) for c in X_test_strings])

# Convert to dense arrays for concatenation
X_train_word = X_train_tfidf_word.toarray()
X_test_word = X_test_tfidf_word.toarray()
X_train_char = X_train_tfidf_char.toarray()
X_test_char = X_test_tfidf_char.toarray()

# Concatenate all feature sets
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char, train_stats])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char, test_stats])

# Class weights for imbalance handling
pos_count = y_train.sum()
neg_count = len(y_train) - pos_count
if pos_count > 0:
    scale_pos_weight = neg_count / pos_count
else:
    scale_pos_weight = 1.0

# Stratified Split for validation - proper hold-out validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Models (Ensemble) on training data only
model_xgb = XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,
    eval_metric="auc",
    objective="binary:logistic",
    random_state=42,
    tree_method="hist",
    verbosity=0,
    use_label_encoder=False,
)
model_xgb.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Logistic Regression
model_lr = LogisticRegression(
    solver="liblinear",
    max_iter=1000,
    random_state=42,
)
model_lr.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validation Metric - compute on held-out validation set
val_probs_xgb = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_probs_lr = model_lr.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_probs_avg = (val_probs_xgb + val_probs_lr) / 2
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs_avg)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate Submission Predictions (Average of full models retrained on full training data)
model_xgb_full = XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,
    eval_metric="auc",
    objective="binary:logistic",
    random_state=42,
    tree_method="hist",
    verbosity=0,
    use_label_encoder=False,
)
model_xgb_full.fit(X_train, y_train)

model_lr_full = LogisticRegression(
    solver="liblinear",
    max_iter=1000,
    random_state=42,
)
model_lr_full.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Generate Submission Predictions (Average of full models)
test_probs_xgb = model_xgb_full.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_probs_lr = model_lr_full.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_probs_avg = (test_probs_xgb + test_probs_lr) / 2

# Create Submission DataFrame matching sample_submission_null.csv format
sub_df = test_df.copy()
sub_df["Insult"] = test_probs_avg
cols = ["Comment", "Date", "Insult"]
sub_df = sub_df[cols]

# Save
sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Final confirmation print
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(sub_df)} rows.")
print(f"Submission has {sub_df.columns.tolist()} columns in correct order.")
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")
